This campaign instead retains real NativeSession authority and endpoint replay/all immutable transport calls/all explicit boundaries/full5job physical audit. It does not claim every internal query was taped. All unlogged query work remains charged to the actual root wall.
scope.entry_capture: Private FunctionType retains original method bytecode and only records each real initial collector result plus immediate owner-only endpoint rereads, including successful final reread. No session proxy or supplied-data authority.
scope.faults: drop3 applies independently to every immutable request and tests initial readiness. OwnerA/B outages .115..2 gate source execution/recipient publication, not ACK delivery. No lawful route-only ACK-drop capability exists in027; it is unavailable, not simulated by a mislabeled outage.
scope.conditional_predictions: Future fault rows are outside normal-delivery point prediction assumptions; actual endpoint/root status and all-five-job outcomes are retained, never upgraded to a model certificate.
scope.timing: 100ms root allocation/60ms decision/40ms finalization reserve are experimental, not WCET. Actual atomic overruns, no baseline, delayed ACK and censor retained. Actual firsthop+deliveredACK+complete drain required; default no-command does not promise next1.
scope.cold: Worker startup/import/44+21 gates/native setup/predictor compilation/shutdown and final export+saved verification retained. External whole campaign is a conservative full-charge sensitivity, never divided by roots.
scope.budget_rationale: One serial18-branch H40 campaign; prior closed44+21 entry/exit cost about18s and small native three-branch campaigns about20s.600s includes every worker, predictor, all native branches and saved verification; this is a finite cap, not a predicted runtime.

new_mechanisms.codec: Original one-fresh normalize and strict decoder retained. Remove only already-validated redundant encoder tree walk; same strict UTF8 compact encoding readback validates all ordered keys and scalar bits before evidence returns.
new_mechanisms.verifier: Repaired defining-module globals plus two-level root predicate binding; fulloriginal code/closures, no weakened checks.
new_mechanisms.failure: Every branch remains in18 denominator. Failures/open/RPC shutdown errors retain unknown; original failed151 producer not rewritten.
new_mechanisms.comparison: Descriptive against independently recovered entry18; full5job strict comparisons within each new normal pair remain required. No causal ABBA native speed claim.

normalization_amendment.boundary: Real native collector first; all closed builtin tuples become fresh lists, not only node/edge rows. This representation conversion is followed by unchanged dynamic field/schema guards; no native authority is minted from JSON.
normalization_amendment.resource_keys: Only conditional model resources: homogeneous exact nonnegative int or canonical ASCII decimal str keys, matching exact integer node identity. All mixed key types, including noncolliding pairs, are rejected.
normalization_amendment.failure_contract: Closed predictor is not restarted; all18 rows retained. Every available lifecycle clock is exact nonnegative int; missing-raw failures retain validated branch attempt clocks distinct from unknown root time. Aborted cleanup never becomes valid CLOSED.
